Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: In Step 11, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the limit was "10 games per year per developer." This conclusion is factually unsupported by the conversation history. The only credible source found (The NES Encyclopedia) explicitly states the limit was "five games per year" for publishers. The Planner hallucinated a "10 games" figure by inventing a rule about using two imprints to bypass the limit as if it were an official part of the limit calculation, rather than a workaround. The Planner failed to correctly interpret the source text which clearly stated "five," and instead fabricated a new number (10) based on an unverified assumption about publisher workarounds, leading to a wrong final answer.
